quests.title: The Pub Map
quests.summary: A damp map found in a pub points to pirate treasure. Follow the clues from the Baths to the dive shop to Norman Island, and beat a rival hunter.

steps.text: Get the map from the landlady at Pusser's Pub.
Find the crab with the clue in the Baths on Virgin Gorda.
Ask the Rhone Dive Shop's guide about Norman Island.
Beat the Treasure Hunter's rival on Norman Island, then dig.

quests.reward: A Doubloon (a charm: spirit moves hurt less).
